- olive_subprocessors_2028-07-13.csv (attached) — current subprocessor roster and regions
- Olive_W9_2028-07-13.pdf (attached) — tax form for PO setup (US entity)

We host our external SOC 2 Type II report on the partner portal — quick link below — and we can also provide a redacted PDF if you prefer.

SOC2 report (public link): https://vendor-portal.olive-sys.com/soc2/report-2027
DocuSign link for DPA (if you want us to e-sign first): https://docusign.com/1234-olive-dpa-sign

Mike — thanks for sending these over and for the clear list. Quick notes from our side: 

1) DPA: we prefer DocuSign. I will route the DPA to Legal for a quick review; if all looks good we'll sign and return via the link. If Legal requests redlines I will flag them immediately.

2) SOC2: appreciated — the portal link is fine. Can you tell me the report date range (start/end) and whether the report includes a list of the control exclusions? Finance sometimes needs the explicit cover period.

3) Subprocessors: we need a simple mapping of subprocessor -> country -> purpose for our procurement intake. The CSV looks good but can you confirm whether any subprocessor processes Redwood customer data (vs telemetry/analytics)?

4) PO: procurement mentioned they need PO number before activation. Vanessa (cc'd) — can you confirm finance's typical lead time on PO issuance once we hand off the completed intake? Ben, looping you for pricing/contract stamps if we need a non-standard PO term.

I'll follow up once Legal reviews the DPA. Thanks again.

— Tessa Morgan
Senior Manager, Vendor Enablement
Redwood Inference

Hi Tessa,

Thanks — answers below inline.

1) DPA: DocuSign route is fine; the link I sent is pre-filled for Olive to sign, then it will route to you. If Legal needs a redline we can accept reasonable changes (we're used to a handful of enterprise edits).

2) SOC2: The report covers period 2027-01-01 to 2027-12-31 and is a Type II with the standard scope for our production environment. There are no control exclusions in the published report. If you want a certified PDF instead of the portal link I can attach a redacted copy.

3) Subprocessors: the attached CSV includes a column labeled "data_scope" — values are either "customer_data" or "operational_telemetry". The only subcontractor that touches customer_data is CloudArchive Ltd (UK) for long-term encrypted backups — listed in row 4.

4) PO fields: our billing contact is finance@olive-sys.com and remit address is on the W9 (attached). As soon as you share the PO number we will proceed with activation. Typical activation window is within 24 hours of PO receipt + signed DPA.

If helpful I can provide a short executive summary of the subprocessor that touches customer_data.

Best,
Mike

Attachments included in this message: olive_subprocessors_2028-07-13.csv (updated), (SOC2 portal link again: https://vendor-portal.olive-sys.com/soc2/report-2027)
